_about: Voice direction for Chatterbox (scripts/make_voice_cb.py). One entry per script LINE (split=line), in order. exag = emotion intensity, cfg = pacing (lower = slower), pause = silence after (s), say = spoken text when it differs, note = acting intention. Timbre: Kokoro bm_george cloned as the reference (out/doomsday/vs/ref_bm_george.wav), picked by the user.
